changes.comment: Fix declared environment input hashing to preserve Windows case-insensitive lookup, distinguish absent and empty values, and snapshot supplied environments before querying operation hashes. Operations with declared environment inputs will receive new cache keys.
Reject declared additional inputs inside operation output folders using platform-aware paths, and only cache fully validated input maps.
Add the lockstep @rushstack/rush-heft-shard-plugin package for managed Heft shard cache identity and execution orchestration.
